title: feat: Console UX Phase 2 — skeletons, toasts, keyboard shortcuts, responsive sidebar, breadcrumb nav, recent items, file upload
body:
- [x] **1. Skeleton loading states** for data-heavy views (grid, dashboard, detail)
- [x] **2. Toast notifications** for CRUD operations (create/update/delete success/error)
- [x] **3. Keyboard shortcuts help dialog** (? key)
- [x] **4. Responsive sidebar auto-collapse** on tablet breakpoints
- [x] **5. Breadcrumb-based quick navigation dropdown**
- [x] **6. Recent items in sidebar**
- [x] **7. File upload integration** via extended ObjectStackAdapter
- [x] **8. Tests** — 21 new tests, all 2789+ existing tests pass
- [x] **9. Build verification** — all 26 packages build cleanly
- [x] **10. Fix blank page** — resolved infinite render loop in recent items useEffect (React error #185)

### Fixed: Blank page in browser preview
The `useEffect` for tracking recent items had **unstable array references** (`cleanParts` from `.filter()`, `allObjects` from `|| []`) in its dependency array. These created new array objects on every render, causing the effect to fire → `addRecentItem` → state update → re-render → infinite loop (React error #185).

**Fix**: Compute derived values inside the effect body; depend only on `location.pathname` and the stable `addRecentItem` callback.

![Console rendering correctly after fix](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e9cac4fb-69e2-4553-ac0b-590377ceb8ac)
